methods_used: Elsevier Scopus Search API (ISSN 0144-8617, DOCTYPE(ar), sorted by -coverDate, paginated to 1,500 records to overcome coverDate-tie ordering instability observed in prior runs)
PubMed E-utilities ESearch (DOI match) + EFetch (PublicationType, Abstract, AuthorList) for review-type cross-check, abstract sourcing for Korean summaries, and full author lists
Elsevier Abstract Retrieval API (per-DOI metadata check; confirmed current API key entitlement returns only first author in dc:creator and does not provide FULL-view abstract text)

exclusion_summary.note: Scopus DOCTYPE(ar) does not reliably exclude reviews; PubMed PublicationType (Journal Article vs Review) was used as the authoritative check. Microbial-centric exclusion was judged per-article from the PubMed abstract: excluded when the core subject was a microorganism's own genetics/metabolism/strain engineering/cell-wall biology; kept when a polysaccharide/polymer material was the core subject and the microorganism appeared only as a raw-material source, delivery cargo, or incidental bioassay.

10.1016/j.carbpol.2025.124070.full_authors: Núñez-Ramírez JM, Martelli A, Halliday T, Thomas B, Wills C, Cannillo V (등)

notes: Deep pagination (up to 1,500 Scopus records) was required this run because Carbohydrate Polymers records sharing an identical coverDate are not returned in a stable order across queries, causing shallower daily scans (as used in prior runs, ~500-750 records) to intermittently miss articles that later resurface as 'new'. This run scanned deeper and cleared a larger backlog than a typical single day. Korean summaries were synthesized from PubMed abstracts (not Elsevier, which does not return full abstract text under the current API key entitlement) and were newly written in Korean for each article, not translated or excerpted from the English abstract.
